fields.subject: SQL Server Provider Package
fields.response: grant visibility of the ArgentSea.Sql assembly's internal types and members to the assembly named $(MSBuildProjectName).Test (this project's own name with a ".Test" suffix) via an InternalsVisibleTo item in the project file
fields.postcondition: the SQL Server provider's own test assembly can exercise its internal implementation directly without those internals becoming part of the package's public API
